articleTitle: SU(4) States of Coherent Photons and Symmetry-Breaking: A Quantum-Classical Crossover
abstract: Coherent photons possess both spin and orbital angular momentum as internal degrees of freedom. We show these states have a symmetry of Special Unitary group of degree 4, SU(4), which could be broken down to SU(2)$\times$ SU(2) states upon projection by a polariser to loose the classical entanglement.

articleTitle: Near Infrared Photopolymerizing Resin Compositions for Light-induced Self-Written Waveguide
abstract: We have investigated photoinitiating systems by using various diimmonium dyes to initiate with a near-infrared (NIR) light source. Light-induced self-written (LISW) waveguides have been fabricated at 1550 nm wavelength to investigate the ability of diimmonium dye/co-initiator system. Microwatt level photopolymerization threshold value was obtained at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Real-time Underwater Channel Transmission Experiment of Robust Gigabit-UWOC System with Dithering by Rotating Mechanical Beam Steering
abstract: We conducted a proof-of-principle experiment of a real-time underwater wireless optical communication system of 1 Gbps, OOK signal with dither added by rotating mechanical beam steering. The dynamic characteristics show that the average power penalty remains within 0.3 dB for a beam steering angle of 0.1 degrees for 2 seconds.

articleTitle: Silicon Based High Resolution Passive Optical Phased Array Consisting of Multi-Mode Waveguides
abstract: We fabricated large scale silicon passive Optical Phased Array consisting of 128 channel Arrayed Waveguide Grating. The beam divergence was less than 0.3° and scan range was over 40°. This passive optical phased array is effective for realization of small size, low power consumption and high-resolution beam scanner.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Distributed Fiber Sensor Detection with Low Complexity and High Accuracy
abstract: Our deep learning model for distributed fiber sensor detection achieves high accuracy 99.29%, recall 66.67%, precision 75.00%, and F1-score 70.59% using an 80/10/10 train-validation-test split. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach and its suitability for distributed fiber sensing applications, especially for low magnitude.

articleTitle: Flight Height Extension of Micro-drones by Light Beam Shape Control of Optical Wireless Power Transmission
abstract: The limited flight time of micro-drones due to small batteries was improved by dynamic charging via optical wireless power transmission. By optimizing the lens configuration to reduce beam divergence, up to 35 cm of vertical flight was achieved with a 35 W VCSEL array output in the limited vertical direction.

articleTitle: Scalability of heterogeneous photonic integrated circuits
abstract: Photonic integrated circuits (PICs) have been widely employed in various applications. However, it is challenging to scale the PICs toward Pb/s capacity. We study the scalability bottlenecks in terms of wideband materials, dense integration approaches, wideband optical sources, and high-efficiency tunable and modulation devices.

articleTitle: Terahertz Wave Beam Steering Using Chromatic Dispersion at Optical Fibers by 4-arrayed Photomixer
abstract: We proposed 4-array beam steering system with terahertz wave phases control using chromatic dispersion at optical fibers. By configuring four optical paths with different chromatic dispersion characteristics, we succeeded to steer a 300-GHz wave beam as wide as 10-degree with optical frequency change of 3 THz.

articleTitle: High-Order Gaussian Beams and Optical Vortices as Rigorous Solutions of Maxwell Equations
abstract: Analytical and rigorous solutions of Maxwell equations for high-order Gaussian beams have been derived, without using paraxial approximation. Vectorial formulation of Laguerre-Gaussian-like beams and optical vortices were obtained. These analytical solutions are useful and effective for understanding the beam characteristics.

articleTitle: Nano-pixel Polarization Rotator for Photonic Integrated Breath Sensor
abstract: Integration available polarization rotator has been proposed using nano-pixel waveguide. $4.2\times 0.96\mu \mathrm{m}^{2}$ region exhibits a polarization extinction ratio of 4.6 dB with excess loss of 5.1 dB in simulation.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Frequency Hopping in 300-GHz Band by Photomixing using Tunable DFB Laser Array
abstract: We demonstrated an optoelectronic frequency hopping system in the 300-GHz band using a tunable DFB laser array and an antennas-integrated UTC-PD chip. The experimental result exhibited a fast-hopping speed of 4.4 GHz/ms in the 300-330 GHz range, which shows great potential for THz secure communication.

articleTitle: One KHz-Order Linewidth-Stabilized Ring-Cavity Fiber Laser Based on Sub-Ring Cavities and Saturable Absorber Hybrid Scheme
abstract: This study demonstrates a narrow linewidth-stabilized ring-cavity fiber laser uses three sub-ring cavities and fiber saturable absorber. The measured laser output power and wavelength change are less than 0.03dB and 0.008nm within 60minutes, respectively. A narrow linewidth of 1.65KHz with and a high optical-signal-to-noise-ratio of 62dB is obtained.

articleTitle: Simulated Spectra and Power of Laser Oscillation and Amplified Spontaneous Emission for Spectral-Broadness-Tunable Littman External Cavity Lasers
abstract: A Littman/Metcalf external cavity diode laser with tunable spectral broadness was verified via simulation using the transmission-line laser model. A spectral-broadness tuning range was revealed to be 250 kHz – 3.9 THz. The output power of the laser oscillation remained constant, while that of the amplified spontaneous emission changed significantly.

articleTitle: High-speed optical modulation through the quantum well intermixing (QWI) semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA)-integration electroabsorption modulator (EAM)
abstract: Photonic integration of semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) and electro-absorption modulator (EAM) has been reviewed. Using local quantum well intermixing (QWI), cascaded EAM/SOA waveguide structure with improved microwave design leads to low transmission loss of-7.5dB, >100Gb/s high-speed optical modulation, and optical amplification of 10dB gain.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Improvement of Relative Frequency Precision in Multi-Wavelength Light Source
abstract: We proposed a multi-wavelength light source which contains four light sources and one common wavelength locker to improve relative frequency precision. The result of relative frequency precision was improved compared to the Micro ITLA’s relative frequency precision. From these results, the advantage of multi-wavelength light source was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cryogenic Integrated Photonics: Where Optical Communication Meets Cryogenic Computing
abstract: We present recent progress in cryogenic optical modulators for data links from cryogenic to room temperature environments, which can have applications in emerging cryogenic classical and quantum computing systems. Two efficient solutions based on III-V alloys and Ce:YIG are presented, utilizing the electro-optic and magneto-optic effects, respectively.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Measurement of Velocity Distribution by Three-Dimensional Spatial Encoding
abstract: This paper presents a differential laser Doppler velocimeter (LDV) for simultaneous measurement of three-dimensional (3D) velocity distribution combining spatial encoding by bias-frequency assignment and wavelength encoding. An experiment to detect one wavelength is conducted as a first step of verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Low-Loss VCSEL Coupler in Si Photonics
abstract: We proposed and designed a Si photonics grating coupler for VCSEL. The CMA-ES evolutionary algorithm was used for optimizing 92 parameters and an average coupling loss of 1 dB was calculated in the C band.

articleTitle: Sixteen-channel CW-WDM wavelength multiplexer based on free-spectral-range insensitive cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers on SOI
abstract: We demonstrate a free-spectral-range insensitive Mach-Zehnder interferometer design for wavelength multiplexing sixteen CW-WDM channels with deviation of $\lt50$ pm to the wavelength grids, an averaged insertion loss of -3dB, and an optical crosstalk of $\lt-13{\mathrm{dB}}$.

articleTitle: High Tolerant Design of Peltier-Free Si Wavelength Filter Using Mach-Zehnder Interferometer for DWDM Application
abstract: High-tolerant design of a Si wavelength filter using a Mach-Zehnder interferometer is proposed for Peltier-free and low power dissipation Si-photonics devices. Numerical results show that the proposed filter has a temperature dependence low enough for use in dense wavelength division multiplexing systems. It is less than 3 pm/K in the entire C-band, and the device has superior characteristics compared with one designed by the conventional method.

articleTitle: Introductory Talk: “How Can Integrated Photonics Boost Quantum Technology?”
abstract: Micro optics and integrated photonics are now playing key roles in the development of quantum photonic technologies. In this introductory talk, by quickly reviewing the contents of the following talks, I will briefly discuss the potential of micro optics and integrated photonics in advanced quantum photonics technologies.

articleTitle: Simulation on Temperature Rise Using Ring-Resonator-Type Device for Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording
abstract: The temperature rise including the recording medium using a novel device, in which a metal nano-antenna is attached to a semiconductor ring resonator, was numerically simulated. We found that a heat spreader surrounding the nano-antenna can significantly reduce the temperature rise of the nano-antenna while heating the recording medium sufficiently.

articleTitle: Microlens-Assisted Expanded Beam Technique for Coupling of Laser Source to Photonic Integrated Circuit
abstract: Efficient coupling interface is crucial for integrating densely-packed photonic sub-assemblies. This study presents a microlens-assisted expanded-mode technique for coupling light from a laser diode into a photonic-integrated-circuit edge coupler. The results show good coupling with relaxed alignment tolerances, paving the way for efficient free-space optical interconnects in chiplet-based photonic packaging.

articleTitle: Carrier Transition Process of Wire-on-Well Quantum Structures Investigated by Using Photoluminescence and Photoreflectance Spectroscopies
abstract: We investigated photoexcited carrier transition in Wire-on-Well (WoW) structures using photoluminescence and photoreflectance measurements. The observed low-temperature photoluminescence peaks showed a blue shift when the excitation power was increased. This result is explained by considering recombination between the quantum states of spatially separated positions in quantum wells of WoW structures.

articleTitle: Signal Quality Improvement in Optical Communication at Varying Bit Rates using Machine Learning: A Preliminary Study
abstract: The long-distance optical communication wavelength-division-multiplexing achieves a 40 Gb/s data rate but needs a dispersion compensator to mitigate dispersion caused by long-distance fiber. The papers suggest employing a multi-layer perceptron neural network model instead to optimize WDM receiver sensitivity and improve signal quality affected by fiber chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Design of a heterostructured valley photonic crystal waveguide supporting a slow-light mode with a large mode width
abstract: We designed a valley photonic crystal (VPhC) waveguide with graphene-like photonic crystals inserted between topologically distinct VPhCs. The waveguide supports a topological slow-light mode with a larger mode width than that in a bearded-interface VPhC waveguide reported before. This will enable slow-light devices carrying large optical energy.

articleTitle: 100 Gbps direct modulation scheme by utilizing active-MMI laser
abstract: We verify the signal modulation possibility of active-MMI laser diode on simulation. The modulation bandwidth is extended over 90 GHz which enables over 100 bps modulation.

articleTitle: Pattern projection using arbitrary shaped microlenses and intentional crosstalk
abstract: A tandem microlens array with arbitrary shaped lenslets projects patterns towards the far-field. Employing intentional channel crosstalk enables dynamic steering of the projected pattern. The micro-optics is mastered by grayscale lithography and replicated as polymer-on-glass element.

articleTitle: Integrated Lithium Niobate Photonics and Applications
abstract: Low-loss thin film lithium niobate photonic platform is poised to revolutionize classical and quantum optical communications. I will introduce the platform and discuss high bandwidth, low voltage, and low loss electro-optic (EO) modulators, EO and Kerr frequency comb sources, frequency domain shifters/ beam splitters and microwave-to-optical transducers.

articleTitle: Polarization-Multiplexed Short-Reach Optical Interconnects
abstract: The conventional direct detection faces the capacity bottleneck beyond 100-Gbps per wavelength, due to its 1-dimension modulation and detection. To increase the spectral efficiency, there emerge a variety of direct detection subsystems based on the Stokes vector receiver (SV-R). In this paper, we review and compare variety of SVRs.

articleTitle: Strong exciton-photon coupling in 2D materials
abstract: Following a brief overview of strong light-matter interaction in 2D semiconductors, we will first present our work on realizing highly nonlinear exciton-polaritons geared towards few photon nonlinearity. We will then discuss our recent work on coupling of magnetically correlated excitons in van der Waals magnets with cavity photons.

articleTitle: Optical technologies for solving social issue
abstract: We have investigated new lasers and optical technologies for fundamental research and solving social issues such as renewable energy, environmental sensing, photo-agriculture, medicine, and space application. The key technology is to expand the oscillation wavelength range and create devices with excellent environmental resistance.

articleTitle: S+C+L Band Tapered Asymmetric Directional Coupler for Broadband Polarization Splitter-Rotator
abstract: A broadband tapered asymmetric directional coupler based on Si waveguide for TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> mode multiplexing was designed. It was fabricated for polarization splitter-rotator for future broadband digital coherent optical transmission system. Fabricated device exhibits broadband mode multiplexing operation with the insertion loss less than 1.9 dB over S+C+L band.

articleTitle: Optical Transition Energy of InAs/GaSb Type-II Superlattice Investigated by Using Photoluminescence and Photoreflectance Spectroscopy
abstract: We measured InAs/GaSb type-II superlattice by photoluminescence (PL) and photoreflectance (PR) spectroscopy to evaluate its transition energy. The excitation intensity dependence of the PL spectra was considered to be due to the band-filling effect. The peak obtained in the PR spectrum were identified as e1-hh1 transition.

articleTitle: Water Flow Detection Optical Sensor Using Flat-top beam Generated by Galilean Telescoping Beam Shaper for Underwater Channel Monitor
abstract: A proof-of-principle experiment demonstrated the feasibility of a water flow detection optical sensor using a flat-top beam-assisted image signal processing. We evaluated whether the discrimination performance of the water flow detection optical sensor, an index of sensor sensitivity, is excellent when comparing Gaussian and flat-top beams.

articleTitle: Beam Steering with Improved Peak Intensity and PSLL for OPA’s Using Novel Grouping Phase Error Technique
abstract: We demonstrate a group phase correction of a 64-channel optical phased array antenna with fitness function weighing both peak intensity and peak-to-sidelobe-level (PSLL) after beam steering. PSLL of 14.96 and12.69 dB with intensity of 0.7 and 0.64 are achieved respectively after group phase correction with PSO and new fitness function.

articleTitle: High-Power Laser Irradiative Optical Fiber Probe Integrated with a Short Temperature Sensor for Laser Ablation
abstract: A novel optical fiber probe with a very short integrated temperature sensor for high-power laser ablation is proposed and was successfully fabricated. Both optical mode and wavelength multiplication were simultaneously performed using a double-clad fiber for laser irradiation and temperature monitoring.

articleTitle: 3D Laser Micro-and Nanoprinting: Status and Perspectives
abstract: We review our recent work on 3D laser micro-and nanoprinting of polymers. We emphasize replacing two-photon absorption by two-step absorption, allowing for using compact continuous-wave laser diodes instead of femtosecond laser systems. Furthermore, we focus on laser printing of semiconductors and metals, allowing for fully printed functional micro-electronic devices.

articleTitle: Novel 3D printing technology without voxel defect for optical application
abstract: LCD 3D printing technology has become popular due to its high printing quality. However, the pixel defect that occurs on the printed surface limits its application. To overcome this issue, a new intelligent LCD panel have been developed in the 3D printing system to eliminate voxel defect caused by the dark zone between pixels. The results successfully demonstrated an ultrasmooth surface without scarifying too much resolution.

articleTitle: Novel terahertz wave power combining technique by arrayed photomixers
abstract: We designed a novel terahertz wave power combiner which combines high-frequency currents from each photomixer in a micro strip line. The experimental result showed that the combined power increases super-linearly with the number of the photomixers, which for the first time confirms a great advantage of photomixing as a current source.

articleTitle: Increased Transmission Distance Range in LED-Based Optical Wireless Power Transmission using Liquid Lens
abstract: LED-based optical wireless power transmission (OWPT) system has been a feasible candidate for powering remote applications. In this research, the novel lens configurations are proposed, and the irradiation performance longer than 1 m distance is automatically optimized. At a distance of 3 m, the effective surface irradiation power is improved by 8 times.

articleTitle: Crack detection using laser displacement measurement system based on signal intensity correlation
abstract: We propose and investigate fine cracks detection on the surface of a step profile object by using a laser displacement measurement system based on signal intensity correlation. The fine cracks with a width of 0.05 mm and their positions are successfully detected by the proof-of-concept experiments.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Ground-to-Satellite Free Space Optical Wireless Communication at Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Range
abstract: High-speed free-space optical (FSO) communication has been a promising technology in the low earth orbit (LEO) region in the last decade. In this paper, we simulate 10 Gbps simplex ground-to-satellite with various wavelengths and transmitter beam pointing error can achieve a bit error rate (BER) of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup>.

articleTitle: Numerical Analyses of All-Optical Gate Switches Using Cascaded Second Harmonic Generation and Difference Frequency Mixing in Quasi-Phase-Matched LiNbO3 Devices
abstract: We numerically calculate characteristics of all-optical gate switches employing cascaded second harmonic generation and difference frequency mixing in quasi-phase-matched LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> devices. Our numerical analyses consider not only the waveforms of the initial optical pulses but also the optical noises on those inputs.

articleTitle: A novel microwave photonic circuit switch design using Period-one nonlinear semiconductor laser dynamics
abstract: A novel Microwave photonic circuit switch design is proposed and demonstrated using P1 nonlinear semiconductor laser dynamics. Channel selection can be optically adjusted by controlling the injection parameters. We have also demonstrated that our design can greatly enhance the input signal quality through the optical modulation depth improvement.

articleTitle: Occlusion and focus cue support for optical see-through augmented reality near eye displays
abstract: Optical-see-through near eye display is a main device for augmented reality applications. Occlusion and focus cue support is important in securing out-door visibility and natural viewing experience. In this talk, various recent techniques enabling the real scene occlusion and monocular focus cue are introduced.

articleTitle: Modulation Format Conversion From One 8QAM to Three BPSK Based on Four Wave Mixing
abstract: Modulation format conversion from 8QAM to BPSK based on four-wave mixing using highly nonlinear fiber is proposed. Calculated BER performance and constellation diagram show that error-free conversion can be achieved.

articleTitle: Tailoring the visual appearance with disordered arrays of resonant metaatoms
abstract: Metasurfaces have flourished in the last few years thanks to their extraordinary capabilities in the manipulation of light. In this work, we propose a theoretical tools and models that can effectively and intuitively predict the visual appearance of disordered resonant metasurfaces and compare their predictions with experimental results.

articleTitle: Construction of laser interferometer consisting of different wavelengths using laser combiner system for fabrication of holographic memory for optically reconfigurable gate array
abstract: A holographic memory having a fine three-dimensional structure formed by liquid crystal composites is expected for the field of optical information processing due to its superior optical functional properties. The holographic memory can be applied to realize fast and numerous reconfiguration contexts by using optical information technique in optically reconfigurable gate array. Therefore, we propose the construction for a laser interferometer consisting of different wavelengths using laser combiner system for fabrication of holographic memory for optically reconfigurable gate array.

articleTitle: X-raying the Universe with Semiconductor Detectors
abstract: X-ray astronomy has revealed the hot and energetic Universe that cannot be seen by other observational methods. Semiconductor detectors has led this field with their superior imaging and spectroscopic performance, and will continue to lead as they advance. Here we review X-raying the Universe with semiconductor detectors.

articleTitle: Proposal of Ultralow-Driving-Voltage Microring Resonator Electroabsorption Modulator for Cryogenic Operation
abstract: A multiple quantum well (MQW) microring resonator (MRR) electroabsorption modulator (MRR-EAM) with an ultra-low driving voltage operation at 4.2 K is proposed for optical interconnection in a superconducting supercomputer. By combining a single MRR and an EAM, a driving voltage is expected to be significantly reduced to as low as approximately 60 mV.

articleTitle: Topological Quantum Photonics
abstract: We review our experiments on the generation and propagation of quantum states of light in topological nanophotonic platforms, specifically, topological protection of biphoton states and path entanglement, and entanglement of different topologies.

articleTitle: Characterization of Doubly Periodic Guided-mode-resonance Grating for Angular Insensitive Bandpass Filter
abstract: An angular insensitive bandpass filter was experimentally demonstrated with use of guided-mode resonance. Wavelength error was smaller than 1 nm against variation in azimuth and polarization angles when incidence angle was within 1 degree.

articleTitle: THz-wave Pulse Frequency-Amplitude Modulation Enabled by Single Wavelength-Tunable Laser
abstract: Based on our devising THz-wave-generation method by photomixing using single wavelength-tunable laser, we design a pulse frequency modulation system. Experimental results show the feasibility of pulsed THz wave generation with different frequencies. Together with the use of a wavelength selective switch, the system can be developed into pulse frequency-amplitude modulation.

articleTitle: Relationships Between Distribution of Dislocation Glide Planes and Carrier Recombination Properties in InGaAs Solar Cells Using Microwave Photoconductivity Decay Mapping and Photoluminescence Spectroscopy
abstract: We investigated the relationships between the distribution of dislocation glide planes and carrier recombination properties in InGaAs solar cells with different open-circuit voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf>) using microwave photoconductivity decay and photoluminescence measurements. The results showed the low V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf> was due to the recombination of the photoexcited carriers with the dislocation-related defect.

articleTitle: Photonic Quantum Computing
abstract: Many efforts around the world are now pursuing the ambitious goal of utility-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computing. Consistent themes are emerging across the field, as teams attempt to scale from existing small systems to the millions of qubits needed for useful applications. Systems partitioning, manufacturability, cooling power, networking, and control electronics are recurring challenges across all qubit technologies. PsiQuantum has pursued a photonic approach, based on qubits implemented using optical photons propagating in lithographically fabricated waveguides. In this talk we will give a broad overview of recent progress, framed against these major scaling challenges. We will describe the basic requirements for photonic quantum computing, the advantages and disadvantages of our approach, and the current state of maturity of the technology.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic Quantum Sources and Circuits in Lithium Niobate Platform
abstract: We report the study of various passive and active optical elements as building blocks for realizing novel quantum photonic sources and circuits including a highly integrated on-chip Bell state generator and a broadband tunable electro-optic switch, all based on bulk or thin-film lithium niobate waveguide platforms.

articleTitle: Canon’s latest activity on micro-optics
abstract: Canon’s original ultra-precision 3D cutting machine achieves sub-true nm accuracy under the cutting process, enabling ultra-precision devices with complex, sub nm optical mirror surfaces that are difficult to achieve by polishing or grinding, including diffraction gratings that used to require special machines, to be realized only by a common cutting process.

articleTitle: 90° nano-pixel bending waveguide toward highly compact reflecting element
abstract: Nano-pixel based 90 ° bending waveguide is demonstrated toward 100% reflecting in a device cavity. 90 ° angle output was successfully confirmed with excess loss of 7 dB at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Compact Silicon MZI Optical Switch with Low Thermal-crosstalk
abstract: Thermal crosstalk of a compact, low-power, high-speed thermo-optical MZI switch was evaluated using a ring resonator placed nearby. Thermal crosstalk is small enough to maintain sufficient classification accuracy even in a 64 × 64 size optical neural networks, which significantly reduces the integrated circuits footprint compared to conventional micro-heater switches.

articleTitle: Investigation of planar antennas for improving modulation characteristics of quantum well optical phase modulators for radio-over-fiber system
abstract: We have designed and analyzed antennas to improve the modulation characteristics of antenna-integrated quantum well optical modulators. We obtained an optimum width of 650 μm and an optimum length of 413 μm for a conventional rectangular patch antenna. We also proposed a new circular patch antenna to reduce the dependence of the phase shift on the rotation angle of a received electric field, showing a large phase shift independent of the rotation angle can be obtained for 60 GHz radio waves.

articleTitle: Pixel Base Optimized Design Method for Compact and Low-Loss Three-Dimensional Silicon Photonic Y-Junction
abstract: Three-dimensional silicon photonic design method was given by fully pixel base optimization. Complete gradients of performance factor using Finite Difference Frequency Domain method and adjoint-variable method realized fast convergence to find optimized structure. Optimized Y-junction showed very low insertion loss and reflection.

articleTitle: Proposal of 5-mode multiplexer using pillar type photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: We propose a 5-mode multiplexer based on 2D pillar square-lattice photonic crystal waveguides with Si pillar and air background. We then evaluated the performance of the device. The device can selectively excite 5 target modes (TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> modes) by choosing the input ports.

articleTitle: See-Through HMD With Triangular Microstructure for High Visibility
abstract: An optical design for a see-through head-mounted display with high visibility is described. This design, which is based on a light guide plate with triangular microstructures, can overcome the limitations of the balance in optical efficiency. The optical efficiency of the virtual image can be larger than the optical efficiency of the real image.

articleTitle: 1 × 4 Nano-pixel Power Splitter Designed using Overlap-integral Method
abstract: 1 $\times$ 4 nano-pixel power splitter is designed using field profile criteria. The finalized power splitter shows all four 0th order modes, low excess loss of 0.1 dB, and low power deviation of 0.004% among all 4 ports.

articleTitle: Thermo-responsive smart glass
abstract: Nearly 40% of global energy is consumed in buildings, of which windows are the least energy-efficient one in building envelopes. An eco-friendly aqueous solution with surfactant is applied as the thermo-responsive dimmers to solve both of the solar radiant and privacy.

articleTitle: Gate Voltage Modulation Nanolasers on the Graphene-insulator-metal Platform
abstract: This study achieved active modulation of nanolasers on a graphene–insulator–metal (GIM) platform using gate voltage. A ZnO nanowire on the GIM platform created a compact plasmonic cavity and the gate voltage provided through a single-layer graphene altered the lasing threshold of the nanolasers by affecting SPP characteristics.

articleTitle: Investigation of stimulated Raman scattering in magnesium fluoride microcavities
abstract: We have successfully manufactured two magnesium fluoride whispering gallery mode microcavities with diameters as small as a few hundred micrometers. Stimulated Raman scattering experiments conducted using these microcavities revealed low threshold levels and ultrahigh quality factors, suggesting a promising potential for their application in nonlinear photonics.

articleTitle: Monolithic Ion Trap Integrated with a Micro Optical Cavity for Quantum Networks
abstract: Monolithic fabrication of ion traps integrated with a micro optical cavity is the building block for large scale ion trap quantum network. The authors designed such traps and successfully trapped single ions. Cavity mirrors with the desired shape and quality are fabricated on optical fibre tips robustly.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Vertical Field Tuning using Nano-Pixel Spot-Size Converter
abstract: Vertical field enhancement is demonstrated using nano-pixel waveguide. As a result, relatively rectangular far-field-pattern are successfully obtained.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Highly Sensitive Hydrogen Sensor Based on Pt-SiO2/Si Microring Resonator
abstract: We propose a compact and sensitive optical hydrogen gas sensor based on a Si microring resonator (MRR) with a Pt-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thin film. The sensing characteristics of a fabricated Si MRR are experimentally investigated. The resonant wavelength shift of approximately 1.5 nm is measured for 4.0 vol.% hydrogen gas, showing a high sensitivity to hydrogen.

articleTitle: Development of Si Microring Resonator Biosensor for the Detection of SARS-CoV-2
abstract: We proposed and fabricated a biosensor based on a Si microring resonator for SARS-CoV-2. We successfully demonstrated the detection of SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid proteins with a concentration of 5 µg/mL using antigen-antibody specific reactions.

articleTitle: Preliminary Investigation of Inverse Faraday Effect using Silicon Waveguide on Magneto-optical Garnet
abstract: We propose a novel method to yield effective magnetic field using lightwave guiding in a waveguide. The inverse Faraday effect (IFE) enables to control magnetization of a medium optically. Nonreciprocal effect due to light-induced magnetic field via the IFE was experimentally investigated in the silicon waveguide on magneto-optical garnet.

articleTitle: Influence of Underwater Turbulence on Orbital Angular Momentum Beam Propagation
abstract: We evaluate the influence ofunderwater turbulence on the orbital angular momentum (OAM) beam propagation by numerical calculation. The influence is quantitatively estimated by mode spectrum indicating the mode purity of the received OAM beam and the beam profiles after the underwater propagation.

articleTitle: High-Performance Optical Convolutional Neural Network Accelerator with High-Speed Optical Modulator and Carrier-Injection-Type Attenuator
abstract: Optical convolutional neural networks have attracted attention because of their parallel processing capability. We demonstrated image restoration with sufficiently small MSE value using high-speed optical transmission system with a high-speed optical modulator and carrier-injection-type attenuators. 0.72 TOPS of multiple-accumulate operations were demonstrated both in simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: First Observation of Slow Light Effect in Nano-pixel Waveguide
abstract: We observe slow light effect in nano-pixel waveguide for the first time as to our knowledge. The achieved slow light effect is with a group index N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</inf> of ~ 8.73 in 1546 nm to 1553 nm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Ultra-high Efficiency Electro-optic Modulator on Thin-film Lithium Niobate
abstract: We propose a thin-film lithium niobate electro-optic modulator with ultra-high modulation efficiency by incorporating optical isolation trenches, which enables closer electrode placement and situates the optical waveguide within a more potent electric field. The proposed modulator achieves a record 1.2 V$\cdot$ cm efficiency while maintaining a wide electro-optic bandwidth.

articleTitle: Corroded Area Detection and Onset Day Estimation of Mango using Hyperspectral Imaging
abstract: Mango is a specialty product of Miyazaki. However, there is a problem with mango stem-end rot, which shows no signs of disease. Therefore, we investigated using two methods to extract features of the reflection spectrum changes before and after the corrosion of mangoes, and according to the presence or absence of the onset of the disease using a hyperspectral camera. We then used these results to identify the corroded parts. As a result, we confirmed that a discrimination index using two wavelengths is effective in identifying the presence or absence of the disease.

articleTitle: Tunable Vernier Series-coupled Microring Resonator Filters Based on Multiple-quantum-well Waveguide
abstract: We have proposed a 2nd-order Vernier Microring resonator (MRR) filter based on InGaAs/InAlAs multiple coupled quantum well to increase the resonant wavelength tuning range and the free spectral range (FSR) for wide and high-speed wavelength tuning in the wavelength division multiplexing systems. Experimental results reveal that the FSR is extended to 9.2 nm from 2 nm.

articleTitle: Generation of terahertz wave at 560 GHz based on photomixing of 560-GHz-spacing soliton microcomb with UTC-PD
abstract: Photomixing of internal mode beat in optical comb is a potential method to generate low-phase-noise THz wave for 6G. Here, we generated a 560-GHz CW-THz wave by photomixing of a soliton microcomb generated from a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> micro-resonator with UTC-PD. We evaluate the phase noise characteristics of generated CW-THz waves.

articleTitle: Radiation Tolerance of Zn-Doped Periodically Poled Lithium Niobate Waveguide Modules toward Space Applications
abstract: Periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) is a key medium in non-linear optics and its radiation tolerance is crucial for space applications of non-linear optics. We conducted irradiation tests of a Zn-doped PPLN waveguide module and confirmed that the modules with pure silica pigtail fibers show no major deterioration with radiation.

articleTitle: Diffractive Optical Networks & Computational Imaging Without a Computer
abstract: We will present our recent work on deep learning-designed diffractive materials for optical computing and computational imaging.

articleTitle: Hybrid Wavelength Tunable Laser Diode using Curved Directional Couplers with Small Wavelength Dependence
abstract: A curved directional coupler with small wavelength dependence of the coupling efficiency was designed, and the characteristics of a hybrid wavelength tunable laser diode using it were evaluated. An ultra-wide wavelength tunable range of 112.6 nm and a side mode suppression ratio of over 40 dB were demonstrated.

articleTitle: OFDR Analysis of Si Photonics Components
abstract: We experimentally analysed the loss and group index of various Si photonics waveguide components using OFDR with a spatial resolution of several $\mu m$. This study suggests that OFDR will be a crucial tool for visualizing internal optical properties of black-box-like large-scale photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence Intensity Dependence of InGaAs MQW on Relaxation Layer Composition on GaAs Substrate
abstract: We have prepared several samples in which the cladding layer and quantum wells for 1.3$\mu m$ emission were grown on top of InGaAs buffer layers with different compositions on GaAs substrate. The composition of the buffer layer was investigated experimentally using photoluminescence for the application of 1.3$\mu m$ lasers.

articleTitle: Multi-point Optical Fiber Remote Temperature Measurement System by Combining Fabry–Perot-interference Sensors and a Wavelength Division Multiplexing Filter
abstract: A multi-point temperature sensing system was developed using reflection-type sensors consisting of a Fabry-Perot interference structure with good temperature characteristics. It can be simply fabricated using a short temperature-sensing region sandwiched between single-mode fibers. It was operated in a dense wavelength division multiplexing configuration using an arrayed waveguide filter.

articleTitle: Inter-Mode Noises Homogenization for All-Optical Hybrid MDM-OFDM Systems Using Subcarrier-Group Power-Loading
abstract: We numerically show the subcarrier performance uniformity in an all-optical hybrid mode division multiplexing and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MDM-OFDM) system with inter-mode sparse subcarrier multiplexing and inter-optical-subcarrier symbol interleaving, using an inter-mode subcarrier group power loading.

articleTitle: Multi-point measurement of vibration displacements with their phase difference using phase-modulated interferometer
abstract: We demonstrate a method to measure the displacement of a vibrating sample at multi points along with their phase differences by using a phase-modulated interferometer. Using a sample vibrating at 80 kHz, we successfully measured the amplitudes of around 35 nm and their phases at three points.

articleTitle: NEO-PGA: Nonvolatile Electro-Optically Programmable Gate Array
abstract: Large-scale, electronically reconfigurable photonic integrated circuits can enable programmable gate array with applications in optical information technology. Phase change materials with large nonvolatile change in the refractive index, can potentially transform these gates, providing one order of magnitude reduction in the device size, zero static energy, and minimal crosstalk.

articleTitle: High-bandwidth silicon micro-ring modulator employing low-loss waveguide bends
abstract: We employ a low-loss waveguide bend design having gradually-changed width and bending radius to realize a high-speed silicon micro-ring modulator (MRM) for o-band. The resultant silicon MRM enables a tuning efficiency of 35 pm/V, a quality factor of 5020, and an electro-optic bandwidth of 55 GHz.

articleTitle: Narrow Spectral Linewidth Wavelength Tunable Laser Diode using Self-injection Locking
abstract: We report a hybrid wavelength tunable laser connected to a high Q fiber Fabry-Perot resonator. The coupling efficiency is controlled by an integrated reflectivity variable mirror. It was optimized by setting the reflectivity to 0.718, and narrow linewidth below 10 kHz was confirmed due to the self-injection locking effect.

articleTitle: 2D Grating Coupler integrated with two Parallel EAMs for Compact PAM-4 Silicon Photonics Transmitter
abstract: A silicon photonic 2-dimensional grating coupler (2D GC) integrated with dual-parallel germanium electro-absorption modulators (Ge-EAM) for generating four-level photonic pulse amplitude modulation (PAM-4) has been proposed. Combining two polarizations of light modulated by two parallel EAMs in 2D GC, high-speed 50Gb/s PAM-4 photo-detected signal has been attained.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient OFDM Modulation and Characterization of Silicon Photonics Micro-ring Modulator
abstract: Employing OFDM in an O-band silicon micro-ring modulator, this work demonstrates the data rate of >55 Gbps and characterizes the properties of the modulator. Specifically, the dynamic and static modulation characteristics are quite different, and a higher modulation efficiency is achieved with insignificant modulation nonlinearity when using high laser power.

articleTitle: Wavelength insensitive three-mode directional coupler designed by wavefront matching method for broadband mode-dependent-loss equalizer
abstract: A wavelength insensitive three-mode directional coupler for mode-dependent-loss (MDL) equalizer is proposed. By using powerful optimization method, the waveguide geometry is automatically obtained, and designed device exhibits almost wavelength independent operation. The proposed device is useful for constructing broadband MDL equalizer used in multiple-input-multipleoutput signal processing in mode-division-multiplexing transmission.

articleTitle: Optical Label Recognition for Two-Symbol QPSK-Coded Labels Using Complex-Valued Neural Network
abstract: Optical neural-network circuit to process two-symbol QPSK labels for photonic label routing is proposed. Aiming to equip with integratable devices, weight value between neurons is controlled in the learning process. Numerical simulation results show that the contrast ratio has 12 dB for all of 16 combinations by two-symbol QPSK labels.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Broadband Spectrometers using Concave Blazed Gratings
abstract: While most spectrometers utilize plane gratings, we demonstrate a miniaturized, two-channel, broadband spectrometer with variable-spacing concave gratings, combining imaging optics and diffraction gratings in one component. The design freedom in the grating corrects most optical aberrations achieving a volume of $\lt 26\times 12\times 10\mathrm{m}\mathrm{m}^{3}$ with high spectral resolution.

articleTitle: Biosensing application of surface-plasmon tip-tapered fiber with gold nanoparticles to albumin detection
abstract: Surface-plasmon tip-tapered fiber with gold nanoparticles is newly verified as remote biosensors at 1550nm-wavelength range by modifying SAM/antibody on gold nanoparticles, extended from conventional refractive-index sensors. The measurement was performed by changing albumin-antigen concentrations, and the associated wavelength-shifts by surface-plasmon absorption were observed, confirming the effectiveness as biosensing.

articleTitle: Spatial Distribution Observation of Sonoluminescence from Acoustic Cavitation Bubbles in Electric-Field-Applied Water
abstract: We have observed spatial distribution of sonoluminescence from acoustic cavitation bubbles in electric-field-applied water by using a commercial digital camera. Luminescence included two colors of bluish white and reddish orange and had a column shape. Luminescent characteristics changed when an electric field was applied to the water.

articleTitle: Filter-based Optical Duo-binary Transmitters using Silicon Photonics Micro-ring Modulator
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the feasibility of filter-based duo-binary signals using a micro-ring modulator for the first time. Despite asymmetric E/O conversion, the optimized bias is still around the resonance point. In this case, a nonlinear equalizer could significantly improve the duo-binary signals, despite its binary intensity levels.

articleTitle: Serially-connecting cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers and ring resonator arrays for wavelength (de)multiplexing CW-WDM channels
abstract: We employed a cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometer for optical interleaving and an array of racetrack ring resonators for optical channelization. Their combination leads to a 100-GHz spaced wavelength (de)multiplexer for CW-WDM with an optical crosstalk as low as -24 dB.

articleTitle: Realization of High-power DFB Lasers with Single and Multiple Partially Corrugated Gratings
abstract: Cascaded partially-corrugated gratings (CPCGs) are designed to realize high-power DFB lasers for co-packaged-optics applications. CPCGs allow for manipulating the longitudinal power distribution in laser cavity to increase output power. By optimizing the grating ratio, >37.837% increase in output power and >97.3% single-mode-yield can be obtained even at high operation temperature.

articleTitle: Terahertz Beam Deflection by Automatic Optical Phase Control
abstract: We developed an automatic terahertz wave beam deflection system based on a hill climbing algorithm and feedback control. With the aid of a silica optical phased array, the 300-GHz beam generated from arrayed UTC-PDs was successfully deflected in the target direction.

articleTitle: Simultaneously Measurement of Refractive Index and Strain by Using Polished Hollow-Core Fiber
abstract: We present a compact open-cavity fiber Fabry-Pérot interferometer sensor by splicing a polished hollow-core fiber between two commercial single-mode fibers. The open cavity length is only 52μm, and we can successfully construct a sensitivity coefficient matrix for simultaneously refractive index and strain sensing.

articleTitle: Fundamental study on propagation using Laguerre-Gaussian beams and correction filters for underwater optical wireless communications
abstract: Propagation simulations using Laguerre-Gaussian (LG) beams and adaptive optics were performed for underwater optical wireless communications to investigate conditions that improve communication quality. We found that combining low-order LG beams with a filter that utilizes the phase conjugation of beams propagating over the same distance without turbulence can improve communication quality while minimizing intensity loss.

articleTitle: Membrane Photonic Devices for IOWN
abstract: Increasing power consumption in the data center has become a social issue. In order to reduce power consumption, the introduction of optical technology into the ultra-short range is highly desired. For this purpose, we are developing the membrane photonic devices, which are heterogeneously integrated with the Si photonic devices.

articleTitle: Proof-of-concept demonstration of remote-driven fiber optics gyroscope for application in autonomous underwater vehicles
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonics-based fiber optics gyroscope for potential application in autonomous underwater vehicle, and is powered by a high-voltage photovoltaic cell through 980-nm laser emitted remotely. The same laser also pumps erbium-doped fiber to generate broadband light at 1550 nm, and the Sagnac signal is detected remotely.

articleTitle: Controlling liquid crystal droplets in aqueous solution
abstract: Optoelectronic tweezers (OET) by using the light-induced dielectrophoresis are applied to control liquid crystals (LC) droplets with a velocity of 180 μm/s for a 30-μm-diameter by applying 6.5 V at 20 kHz. The ability to control anisotropy and birefringent LCs by OET is promising for finding more photonic applications.

articleTitle: Polarization-Maintaining Single-Transverse-Mode 10 W Er/Yb-Codoped Fiber Amplifie for Space Communication Operating with Continuous-Wave Signals
abstract: Space optical communication is a growing field. Nikon and JAXA are developing a spaceborne single-transverse-mode 10 W polarization-maintaining Er/Yb-codoped fiber amplifier for modulated continuous-wave signals. The amplifier will be demonstrated on the International Space Station in 2024 as part of an optical communication system.

articleTitle: Calibration and Analysis of Microscopic Hyperspectral Imaging and its Applications on Micro-Optics
abstract: We have established a microscopic hyperspectral-imaging system with calibration of automatic control setup based on the monochromator applied to measure the spectral response of hyperspectral imaging. We have also developed a user interface for hyperspectral analysis, which can be used for the measurement and analysis of micro-optics with micron scale.

articleTitle: High-Quality Incoherent Digital Holography Imaging with Interference Fringe Super-Resolution
abstract: We proposed an optical system of incoherent digital holography combined with coded aperture imaging. Simulations confirmed that the application of compressed sensing enables the acquisition of interference fringes at a higher resolution than that of the camera and improves the quality of the reconstructed image.

articleTitle: Nb2O5-based Grating Coupler Design in Integrated Probe for 3D Velocity Distribution Measurement
abstract: A grating coupler based on $\text{N}\text{b}_{2}\text{O}_{5}$ waveguides in the integrated probe for three-dimensional (3D) velocity distribution measurements is presented. Multiple layers under the grating core are designed for improving the coupling efficiency of both the input and output grating couplers.

articleTitle: High repetition FMCW measurement using direct modulation of a hybrid wavelength tunable laser diode
abstract: High repetition FMCW distance measurements were performed using direct modulation of a hybrid wavelength tunable laser at a repetition rate of 25 kHz. A minimum standard deviation of 0.3 cm at a bandwidth of 1.6 GHz was obtained for the same distance measurement in free space. A measurement error of less than 1 cm was achieved for the 3D imaging, demonstrated fast and accurate FMCW distance measurement.

articleTitle: Hybrid Integration of Active III-V on Standard SOI Photonic Platform Based with GACC Methods
abstract: The hybrid integrated photonic platform with grating-assisted codirectional coupler (GACC) is proposed to improve light coupling from an active III-V device to a standard SOI waveguide. The coupling efficiency could achieve 90% even when the III-V and SOI chips are bonded with a 100-nm thick adhesive layer.

articleTitle: A Buried Heterostructure Laser Diode Based on High Thermal Conductivity Silicon Carbide Substrate
abstract: A buried-heterostructure laser diode based on a silicon carbide substrate has been proposed and demonstrated. Using quantum well intermixing and wafer bonding technique, an InGaAsP buried-heterostructure waveguide was formed and bonded on SiC substrate, leading to high optical power of CW >4 mW, low transmission loss, and good cooling performance.

articleTitle: Review of Semiconductor Lasers in Long Haul Optical Fiber Communications
abstract: The single transverse-mode lasers for telecommunication will be reviewed in terms of light output power, power consumption and reliability, together with high power tunable lasers.

articleTitle: Microoptics Integrating smartphone applications reader with paper-based analyser for accurate estimation of nickel in water
abstract: The estimation of nickel ions in water is critical from a human health perspective. Herein, we demonstrate the usability of a paper strip analyzer coupled with a smartphone application reader for accurate estimation of Ni<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> ions in water. The limit of detection of the proposed technique is found to be 0.764 μM.

articleTitle: All-glass 3D-printed fiber couplers
abstract: We apply three-dimensional micro-printing techniques for fused silica in the fabrication of low cost, flexibly-designed allglass waveguides. For the proof of concept, a 3-to-1 fiber-waveguide-fiber optical coupler with three 800 μm long tapered waveguides suspended in air, ideally aligned with the fiber facets, was fabricated. The measured coupling loss is 1.7~2.7dB/facet at a wavelength of 632nm.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics based multi-functional integrated optical circuit with hybrid integrated III-V photodiode for fiber optics gyroscope application
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber optics gyroscope by employing a silicon photonics multi-function integrated optical circuit with hybrid integrated photodiode on top of grating coupler. This approach enables a high polarization extinction ratio of 51.3 dB when the light propagates from fiber coil to the photodiode, thus enables tactical-grade gyroscope performance.

articleTitle: Arrayed Polymer Spot Size Expander applicable to Silicon Photonics Chip for Coupling to Single Mode Fibers
abstract: Realization of high coupling efficiency and wide positional tolerance between multi channels of Silicon photonics chip and arrayed single-mode fibers is a challenging issue. To overcome this problem, we proposed integration of arrayed polymer spot size expander which is fabricated by the self-written waveguide technology using UV-curable resin.

articleTitle: Nonradiative Recombination Centers Mapping of Oxygen Precipitates in p-type Si Using a Laser Heterodyne Photothermal Displacement Method
abstract: Photoluminescence and laser heterodyne photothermal displacement (LH-PD) mapping were observed the distribution of radiative and nonradiative recombination centers, respectively. The in-plane distributions of impurities and oxygen precipitates were observed. Moreover, the LH-PD method could observe the in-depth profile of nonradiative recombination centers.
